Calcutta High Court hears multiple TMC-related cases, party faces internal disputes

The Calcutta High Court is hearing several cases involving leaders and factions of the Trinamool Congress (TMC). These include pleas for anticipatory bail, bail in an illegal occupation case, and contempt proceedings related to a rally. The court has also sought affidavits from party leaders and questioned actions like freezing bank accounts. Additionally, the TMC is experiencing internal disputes, with one faction reportedly taking control of party headquarters.
